Hana: Quick heads-up for the KPI sync — launch-post MQLs dipped during the webinar push window even though overall sessions spiked. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/launch-posts

Tom: I saw that. Breakdown shows a jump in "unknown" channel attribution for that period. Could be the redirect losing UTM.

Priya: Pulled a sample from the reg table. Many rows with utm_campaign=NULL but referrer set to webinar-provider.com. SQL I used:
```
SELECT referrer, utm_campaign, count(*)
FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-18' AND created_at < '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY referrer, utm_campaign
ORDER BY count DESC;
```
Result: ~210 rows with NULL utm_campaign and referrer containing webinar-provider.com

Tom: Ops rolled a redirect tweak on Mar 17 for the provider. @ops-bot can you surface the 302 logs for that window?

ops-bot: Pulling nginx access logs for 2026-03-17 00:00-23:59. Noting several 302 responses where querystring appears empty after redirect. Link: https://logs.redwood.ai/redirects/4851

Hana: Proposed action: 1) add a referrer->campaign fallback in ETL so dashboard counts are more resilient; 2) reprocess last 48h once fallback is deployed; 3) include an "attribution note" slide in Friday's KPI review showing raw vs reprocessed numbers.

Priya: Tiny PR incoming for ETL fallback. Snippet in the transform: `campaign = coalesce(utm_campaign, parse_referrer(referrer))`. Will run a dry reprocess locally and attach CSV diff.

Tom: If we reprocess, please coordinate with Sales imports to avoid duplicates. I'll notify sales-ops and request a 20m pause during re-ingest.

Hana: For the KPI deck I'll include before/after charts and a one-line recommendation: standardize on campaign-first ingestion and add referrer fallback for legacy redirects.

Priya: Uploaded dry-run CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/tmp/launchpost-reprocess-diff.csv — shows ~+32% MQLs recovered for the launch-post cohort in the window.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: infra/etl#1227 in ~9 minutes. Will post status updates here.

Hana: Thanks team — let's reconvene 12:30 ET to confirm numbers before the KPI sync. :rocket:
